EXHIBITIONS (Solo)
2014

2013
Exhibition at ArtCore Gallery (Brewery Annex), Los Angeles, California.

EXHIBITIONS (Group)
2014
“LATITUDE 34-40” Curated by Cynthia Penna at Villa Di Donato in Napoli, Italy.

The Masur Museum (Monroe, Louisiana) 51st Art’s Annual showcases contemporary artists, Curated by Kelly Shindler, Associate Curator at the Contemporary Art Museum St. Louis (CAM), Missouri.

“SQUARED” at The Cloyde Snook Gallery, Adams State University, Alamosa, Colorado, Curated by Mr. Eric Berkemeyer, Curatorial Assistant, Denver Art Museum (Denver, Colorado) and Mr. Randy Pijoan, a visual artist, lecturer, educator and founder of Ventero Open Press Fine Art, San Luis, Colorado.

“Drawing Backwards” exhibition with WCD (West Coast Drawing) at Wells Fargo Bank-CAP Gallery in Laguna Beach, California.

“Honest Media” exhibition at Pacific Beach Library in San Diego, California.

“InMotion” exhibition at South Bay Lexus in Torrance, California.

AWARDS
2013
Second place at “LBA Open” in Long Beach, California. Curated by Peter Mays, Director at Los Angeles Art Association.

Second place in “Big & Small” at Long Beach Art in Long Beach, California. Curated by Ron Linden.

Third place in “2013 Juried Open” at Topanga Canyon Gallery in Santa Monica, California. Curated by Om Navon Bleicher, Director of BG Gallery.

PUBLICATIONS
2013
INDA8 (International Drawing Annual) Manifest Annual Book, Cincinnati, Ohio.
